description: §7.3.5 (S480) clean neg — no W-UNUSED-BINDING: every `<each>` binder is read — in an interpolation, an attribute, an event handler's argument, a row `if=`, the `<each>`'s own `key=`, inside a nested `<each>` (as its `in=` and in its row), or through `@.` (an alias of the binding, §17.7.3) — or is `_`-prefixed (`as _row`), or is not written (an `<each>` with no `as`).
rationale: §7.3.5: an `<each>` binder is reported only when "nothing in the row reads" it — "its markup, attributes, handlers, a nested `<each>` or component inside it, and the `<each>`'s own `key=`"; "a read of `@.` in the row is a read of the binding"; "An `<each>` written without `as` binds no name of the author's and is not reported."
